avis.titre: So good, & I don't write reviews!
avis.texte: So i tested this sunscreen for a month. Its so dewy. So moisturizing. My skin is literally moisturized all day. All day i glow. Literally. I receive compliments all day every day on my skin. I will only use this.
I love this moisturizer. It is very hydrating to the skin and does give a dewy glowed appearance.
Love this sunscreen. Goes on smooth feels lightweight and no white cast. I leave this in my purse so i can easily apply some when I get in the car or when I am out and about
I love this sunscreen. It's nice, dewy and doesn't break me out. I don't wear a lot of makeup so this keeps my skin looking moist and fresh.

avis.titre: 10 out of 10, I use the regular and the tinted!
avis.texte: This makes my skin look and feel so moisturized. I have used this for years and have purchased for my daughter to use also.

This has been a staple in my skin care routine for about 3 months and I couldn't imagine using another sunscreen. It is great for melanin skin tones because it does not leave a cast and leaves a beautiful glow without looking oily. It's also a great base under makeup.
I thought it was supposed to give you a Dewy look. Nope. Just another moisturizer with SPF50.

I have to recognize the fact that this product does hydrates my skin very well. I wanted to love it 😔 but I find out that the ingredients were causing me severe migraines. Unfortunately, I had to stop using it😔

avis.titre: Amazing but the packaging needs to change
avis.texte: I love this & have used it religiously. However I've noticed that with the last 4-5 purchases the pump doesn't work. I have to pump 17-20 times just to get product out which hurts my finger & hand. So instead I screw the cap off & disregard it completely. I don't want to change sunscreens either because I love this one.
Excellent 2 in Number ONE Moisturizer!! Dew Glow Moisturizer SPF 50 is my Number 1 choice
Added this for daily spf and it feels really good on my skin, and leaves no noticeable trace, blends right into skin.

avis.titre: Finally a sunscreen that doesnt pill!
avis.texte: I have tried numerous sunscreens and the all pill under makeup and even on their own. This one does not. It is very dewey and moisturizing so I use this as my moisturizing step.
I love the healthy glow and the hydration. Please do not discontinue this product. Love it.

I love this product. Gives my skin a wonderful glow on days I dont want to wear make up. Feel confident in its ability to protect my skin when I wear my foundation which is more skin care and does not give me any spf. I use two pumps and its perfect for my face and neck.
Love it. I got this mini for my purse. I already have the bigger size

Love this spf and how it leaves a glow on my skin without it feeling so oily. No breakouts, it depends on your skin type. I do think they could do better with the applicator as i have to shake and pump a couple of times but other than it i'd definitely purchase again!
This right here is GOLD, I like how my face glows nice and shiny while it does what it's supposed to do. Will continue to buy and it's affordable than some other brand.
Feels super thick and greasy EXACTLY like body sunscreen. It also still has some white cast if you are tan so I can't imagine it being clear on darker skin.

I bought this due to the ratings, and it's chemical formula - I've never liked the feel of mineral sunscreen (at least the affordable ones) so high hopes! It does feel wonderful on my skin, and doesn't take too long to soak in, but I can't say I'm a fan of the "dew glow" effect. It's acceptable when I first put it on; however, my normally dry, sensitive skin just looks greasy over the course of the day, which doesn't normally happen. And you can imagine this makes reapplying unpleasant. Still a nice product that seems to work for many, and the formula feels nice.
Ive never had a resction to a moisturizer before. I would NOT say that I have sensitive skin. This moisturizer made my face BRIGHT read and super itchy. I do not recommend.

avis.titre: thick in a not-nice and buttery way
avis.texte: i've tried a LOT of sunscreen and this has got to be on the bottom of my list. it's thick but dry feeling and does not rub on smoothly

Love everything about this product except for that dang pump/tube! It feels great on my combination skin, doesnt break me out, gives my skin a nice (but not greasy) glow, doesnt sting my eyes. But that pump. I hate it so much. Sometimes I'll pump 10-15 times and nothing comes out! And its full! Other than that though, its great.

2-in-1 moisturizer and SPF! I liked this moisturizer because it was thick and had a 2 for 1 bonus. Although, while i like thicker products, this did feel heavy on my skin. I also didnt like that it couldnt be used as a night time moisturizer but still a good product overall!

If you are more on the oily side or use a lot of hydrating products, toners, etc. before sunscreen, I'd pass on this one. I am more combo, but would rather use hydrating toners at the start of my skincare. This sunscreen on top of that is overkill. Absolute discoball, shine-bright-like-a-diamond kinda vibe. This would definitely win over the more dry diva.
I really like this product and the way it makes my skin look.

avis.titre: A lot goes a long way
avis.texte: I love this for mature skin it left me feeling hydrated and UV protected. Only thing id say for first time users the cap with the measuring end is and was too much for me i say use a little and rub it in and then more as you go. Plus had a hard time getting the product out of that cap with nails on.

Only sunscreen EVER that has worked for my skin. I was always preaching sunscreen but never consistent due to irritation, breakouts, etc. This product has me religiously applying SPF daily. My skin feels so nice throughout the day, non greasy, clear, calm. I have peace of mind that I'm now able to diligently protect against UV.

Love how this glides on and vanishes into my skin. Perfect daily moisturizer! Love that it has me covered spf! Only flaw is the applicator, not sure if I got a broken one but doesn't look or perform like any applicator I've ever seen! No big deal
This stuff is AMAZING!! 50 yrs young and this makes me glow under my makeup! I rave about it my friends! I normally cannot stick to one thing, but I will be sticking w this.

avis.titre: Repurchasing - and that is saying a lot!
avis.texte: I have tried countless SPFs, and this one is probably in my top 2 faves ever! My other favorite is Paula's Choice, so this one being on the same level as that brand says a lot! It looks great under my daily BB cream and i get tons or compliments on my 30+ year old complexion all the time. Love!

avis.titre: Demi Morgan Lines, Dry under eye , Stinging under eyes
avis.texte: Hands down 10 out of 10, It gives you a very great glow, I suffer from dark under eyes due to allergies, due to having inflammation as well. This does not sting under my eyes( your eyes are very thin and have thin skin). I been using this 3 weeks and i want to put everyone on. I bought the same size and this is now my go to sunscreen. I apply it day and night, but AM is just fine. I really been on my skin care journey. I have acne prone skin and it will not break you out, no stinging, no irritation, the smell is great, the texture is thick but rubs in the best way.

I've been using the Naturium Glow Moisturizer spf 50 for about a week now and I am so pleasantly surprised by how much I love it! My skin is finicky and it hasn't broken out which is almost always a thing my skin does whenever I introduce a new product. The glow is phenomenal without being tacky the smell is light to minimal and goes away while on. It's skincare with SPF and a glow! What's not to be happy with! Definitely need to repurchase!

avis.titre: I use this daily and have been loving it
avis.texte: This hits all notes I was looking for in a moisturizer and SPF! This spreads easily, dries quickly and does not leave you with a white cast. This leaves me even toned and that's very notable for me. I have sensitive combo skin and have been searching for something that does not cause me to break out. This also doesn't have a strong scent to it with being an SPF combo. I will re purchase.

I have been using this product for about a year and a half and it is the only product that has finally restored that youthful illumination/glow to my dull, dry, menopausal skin! I love the fact that it has SPF 50. Will always have this with me for home and travel every day use.

i really love this product: i've been using it for almost 2 years and have recommended it to many people who i know. this product really leaves the skin dewy and glowy and blends into your skin nicely (as long as your face has no water on it!!!!) and leaves no white cast. i apply less than recommended (a capful - they have a little semisphere at the top of the cap to measure) and it lasts pretty much the whole day until i shower and cleanse in the evening. i wouldn't say a cleansing oil/ is required to get it off, but certainly useful. people complain about how the sunscreen burns - and yes, you do have to be careful around your eyes. i only put it on my under eyes and not my eyelids to prevent this. the sunscreen also has niacinamide in it which is brightening!

Run away don't walk!!! This product brokw me out into a rash! I'm not a face care type of girl but I was recommened this produce by an ulta worker when going in to get matched for foundation!!!! I wish I would have never got it!!! Tears and any liquid that touches my face BURN!!!

avis.titre: Broke me out so bad! I...
avis.texte: Broke me out so bad! I used this a few times, and I got big, deep zits all over my cheeks. Once I stopped using my skin went back to normal.
Really liking the texture of this and will purchase a full size. Feels hydrating but absorbs quickly. Love the travel side to bring in a purse or bag for reapplication.

This is the only sunscreen I have used for the last 2 years. I have tried others, but once this one touched my skin I was sold. I love the glow this product leaves on the skin. It does take a little bit of time to settle into the skin. I have had people stop me to ask what makeup I have on, just for it to be this product. 1000% recommend.

I LOVED the way this looked and felt after application. Unfortunately, it made my whole face have these tiny rough bumps, and bigger pimples on my cheeks. Skin went back to normal after I stopped using it :/ So sad, wanted to be able to use it!!

avis.titre: Broke me out in a rash
avis.texte: bought this because my normal face sunscreen wasn't in store. I used it for two days, and my whole face broke out in a rash. Immediately returned and bought my usual sunscreen from Hero. Also, the days I did use the sunscreen, it made my skin so oily and made my makeup look awful on top.
I love the light weight, and ease of application. It leaves my skin soft and glowy.

I never write reviews but this sunscreen gave me a red rash. My skin was so itchy I had to scratch till my skin burned. Every time I use this sunscreen my lymph nodes started to pop out and the sunscreen separates so badly. It doesn't smell good either I don't know if it's a bad batch they gave me. Please don't buy this sunscreen for your own sake I wish I never used it. I won't buy anything from this place again.

avis.titre: The only moisturizer you will need!
avis.texte: I absolutely love this product! I get compliments every single time I just wear this. My skin looks sooo glowy while also being protected from the sun. Win Win! I am always repurchasing this product:)

I've been using this since it first came out, and have repurchased it more times than I can count. I have dry, sensitive, acne prone skin and this is a holy grail for me. I do think this may be better for normal to dry skin, as it may be too much for oily skin types. On my skin it's glowy, hydrating and wears well under makeup. LOVE this sunscreen and moisturizer!!!

I put on this sunscreen and it does the job but after 30 or so minutes, these white flakes pop up on my face from the moisturizer. It is insanely frustrating and I only found out because someone had mentioned it. I would just stick with normal sunscreen, no clue why this product does it.

avis.titre: I would buy this product again because it works really well
avis.texte: I love this product, it is light and feels good going on. A little goes a long way and it works good with my older skin.

As a dry skin girl I have a hard time finding moisturizers that actually work. This product is amazinggg on my dry skin and I love the dewy finish. I only use one pump, using more than that caused my eyes to burn throughout the day. As long as you don't over do it, you should be fine.

This is such a nice moisturizer before applying makeup. It creates a beautiful canvas and isn't oily for me. Theres no white overcast which is definitely a must for me. I have already repurchased twice

avis.titre: Beautiful under makeup but not so much alone.
avis.texte: I get many compliments when I wear this under makeup. It leaves a beautiful glow that last throughout my work day. Alone (not wearing makeup) it feels heavy/greasy, looking oily/shine. There for I'd only wear it with makeup. I have normal, combination skin, oily T zone, age 50s.
You don't need much. Not left feeling greasy and sweaty. Does great when I go to gym.

This feels like it just sitting right on top of my skin, not sinking it or moisturizing. I got the untinted kind. I haven't notice it leave the sunscreeny white cast or anything. But it is greasy and feels like it's sliding on top of my dry, dry skin. I'll go back to Kiehls, I think.
I don't think I've loved a moisturizer this much in years. It's creamy yet lightweight & glides right across your skin. It soaks right in to give you a nice dewy look.

I like the actual product. However the packaging is terrible. I have to pump it like 50 times to get it going, and then the first pump comes out all lumpy because it's been exposed to air or dried out or something, so the first pump is usually wasted product. Would much rather have this product in a normal squeeze tube or a tub with a screw top. Won't be purchasing it again for this reason.
It is the best moisturizer and sunscreen together. I have this in the one with a little tent in it, and they are both amazing.

One of the best sunscreens I've used so far. Living in Miami, sunscreen is a must. Dew-Glow provides great coverage and protection. I love that it already has moisturizer, so I can skip a step after applying serum. It leaves my skin with a radiant glow.

Big fan of this sunscreen. I like the size of the tube because it's easy to travel with and I appreciate the high level of SPF. Sunscreen is moisturizing. Sometimes it's hard to get product out of tube when more than half way empty.
Do NOT buy this product! I do not have sensitive skin and I used this SPF for the first time on my face and it caused my eyes and eyelids to swell so much for 2 days. AVOID!
I like the coverage and likes how it doesn't leave a white cast on my face and not overly oily ,as I already have oily skin.Im around Halle berry 's complexion .
I have sensitive skin. This sunscreen goes only easily, doesn't break my skin out, and is invisible. For the first time, I'm able to wear sunscreen daily!
No white cast, not super oily BUT dewy— which is hard for brands to differenciate. It is so hard to find a good, high SPF. I've been using this SPF for about a year now! Highly reccomend it!
Not too shiny, smelly, or any downaide really. Love the vitamin c in if!

My 50 yr old, dry skin LOVES this! It keeps me dewy and hydrated all day, and wears well under makeup. I do feel this is better for dry skin. For me this has been a holy grail the past 2 years. I've repurchased it more times than I can count.
I tried this for a while and its not for me. It feels like an oily occlusive mask. I will use the rest of the bottle on my hands.

avis.titre: It's the best SPF moisturizer on the market!
avis.texte: I can't say enough good things about this moisturizer. I love that it doesn't leave a white cast or make my face feel sticky like other SPF moisturizers. I used to dread using SPF moisturizers until I tried this one.

avis.titre: It's the best SPF moisturizer on the market!
avis.texte: I can't say enough good things about this moisturizer. I love that it doesn't leave a white cast or make my face feel sticky like other SPF moisturizers. I used to dread using SPF moisturizers until I tried this one.

I was impressed by the white formula actually absorbing into my skin and not leaving a white cast. It gives great sun coverage (I live in Denver and need to wear sunscreen daily). I also love how it makes my skin look dewy!
I'm on my third tube! I have oily skin, and this sunscreen has been the best I've ever used!
If all sunscreens made your skin look this glowy and protected at the same time, I believe more people would make sure to wear it. I have gone through so many tubes of this! It's so good 💜

This product is not skin changing. I have avoided chemical suncreens for a long time due to my sensitive skin, sweat/water causing it to run down into your eyes, and that they are NOT reef safe. My skin is no longer sensitive and I bought this due to the reviews. It did not make my skin "glow" or look brighter. I got acne and stinging/burning eyes instead. I am glad I bought a mini.

My skin looks SO BEAUTIFUL AND HEALTHY after using this sunscreen. I like to apply it in two layers to make it easier to apply. Even though it has the measuring feature in the cap, I've just been using about 2 pumps because it's enough to evenly cover my entire face. I only give it four stars because it has a slight sunscreen smell. It doesn't bother me too much, but it's definitely there. Also it sits perfectly under makeup and makes it look FLAWLESS!!
I love this sun screen. My face looks so healthy and glowing.

This makes my acne prone skin feel so nice! I love all the ingredients in this. It really absorbs into the skin so nice and doesnt leave a heavy feeling that some sunscreens do. If you dont like a dewy look, this wouldnt be for you because it's insanely glowy. (A pro for me). Even with Hyperhydrosis, this keeps my extremely fair skin from getting burnt. Seriously love this!!!
Love this product!! A reasonably priced sunblock with moisturizer. Works great under makeup, especially in the heat. Just bought my second tube, the jumbo one this time.

I was honestly 50/50 before purchasing this, but wow! The glow is not overwhelming it's just the right amount and you literally look like you have a filter. When j filled the cap (handy btw) i was thinking "this is way too much, it won't blend in and I'll be shiny" but NOPE it is literally perfect, i wear it otw work and easily reapply it without any kind of pilling. I highly highly recommended it's definitely a renew staple for me.

I really enjoyed the Dew-Glow Moisturizer SPF 50+. It goes on smoothly, is light weight, dewy (but not shiny!) and wears well under make up. The pump keeps it mess free, which is a big plus for me. On days that I don't want to wear make up I mix a pump of the tinted Dew-Glow moisturizer in this and I am good to go!

This moisturizer saves so much time! It is moisturizing, easy to apply, and has SPF built in so you can skip a step most days (I still apply a separate spf on like beach days bc extra coverage never hurts!) but this is a great daily go-to esp for those on the go! It's easy to reapply and the tube fits nicely in most purses. It's gentle, nourishing, has protective and protective benefits. What's not to love?! Oh and the lid has a space so you can be sure you're using the proper amount of product to get the protection you need!! They literally took the guesswork out of it. Thanks Naturium!!
I don't typically have sensitive skin and this breaks me out everytime i use it. Definitely smells like sunscreen not in a good way.
I don't typically have sensitive skin and this breaks me out everytime i use it. Definitely smells like sunscreen not in a good way.

Im a middle-aged mom with combo skin and some sun damage. I should have been wearing this when I was a lot younger. take it from me people! start putting sunblock on in your teens. sun damage is no joke. I like this formula because it moisturizes my face without adding to the oil slick that is my face. the sunscreen makes me feel better. I haven't tried the tinted one because those usually irritate my skin, but I'm really liking this brand.

As an Ulta employee & a ginger skinned woman who has tried every sunblock, this is the best out there. If i had to pick a single product to recommend it would be this. It makes my skin look incredible. It does not break me out (im acne prone and sensitive). It sits beautifully under makeup. When I do not wear makeup it gives me the most natural glow. I get compliments all the time. This product makes me enjoy wearing sunscreen. I cannot recommend this enough. It gives glass skin! I got it because my skincare obsessed 60 year old mom loves it. So its great on mature skin as well. I could bathe in this stuff. 1000/10

As an Ulta employee & a ginger skinned woman who has tried every sunblock, this is the best out there. If i had to pick a single product to recommend it would be this. The perfect every day spf! layers beautifully under makeup as well & doesn't leave a white cast.
really good for my combination skin and it doesnt feel gross when applying it. im pretty sweaty but it still held up underneath my makeup, its so good as a skin prep for makeup.

honestly everyone has their own preferences but ive tried many sunscreens and this one has been one of the best ones i have tried! it doesnt burn my eyes nor have a sunscreen texture or smell, it leaves my skin glowy but not oily or heavy but feels great on my dry skin. I 100% recommend this to anyone who has dry skin!

Wearing on skin in attached photo: Naturium Moisturizer SPF 50, ILIA True Skin concealer, Benefit Play Tint blush I've been wearing this product for years now and I cannot recommend it enough. I often mix it with a couple drops of foundation and it creates an amazing glowy base. I can layer concealer under or over it without pilling, my main issue with other products. In the summer I do find I have to set my T zone with powder, but I would do that with any foundation. also the packaging is great at getting out every drop. Im turning 30 soon and I think my skin looks great for my age and has very few fine lines, I largely credit the SPF in this product.

I've been trying to find a good cruelty free morning spf moisturizer without any mica in it, and i received a deluxe sample of this. I liked it so much I ordered a full size and will likely keep it as my AM moisturizer of choice! It has good skincare benefits in addition to the spf, and i find it goes on nicely and absorbs well without any white cast or pilling. Its also very hydrating. Its true that you need to use a lot to get the full spf benefits, but this is true for any spf. It is a heavier moisturizer, and i do find that if i dont follow it with a healthy amount of setting powder, ill look greasy. I imagine if you have dry skin, though, this would look very nice and dewy. For me, the setting powder does the trick, and the moisturizer wears nicely under my powder foundation too. Ive also has no irritation or breakouts from it. Overall, its a win for me!

I wanted to love this product. Might be the first product from Naturium I haven't liked. It just makes my skin look greasy instead of glowy. It also pills with my other products. I love the packaging and the lid however.
Made me extremly oily and has a weird texture that does not spread evenly on the skin. Do not reccomend
Fabulous moisturizer, excellent texture with a built-in SPF. I tell people about it all the time.

I fully admit I was influenced; I saw this as "Tiktok viral" and a "bestseller", and I love other Naturium products, so I felt confident in switching from my current tinted SPF moisturizer (from Dermtlgy) and trying this out. However, I was so disappointed after trying this moisturizer -- it sits on my skin heavier than a sunscreen and leaves such a shiny, oily sheen (and I don't even have oily skin). This is also the first skincare product that made my skin breakout, and I very very rarely get breakouts. I had to cake my skin in mattifying powder just to tone down the oiliness from this product. I should have read reviews on other sites, but this one is an unfortunate miss by Naturium. I highly recommend DRMTLGY's Universal Tinted Moisturizer instead.
One of my favorite moisturizer with an SPF in it, I work in the skin care industry and have tried many moisturizers and this is fabulous. I am on my third bottle.

Wrote a longer review on the tinted version, but I was very pleasantly surprised by this American sunscreen, I would totally repurchase, especially in the winter! Very easy to use, great supporting ingredients for when I just want to slap it on and go!

This Dew-Glow Moisturizer SPF 50+ is so good! It's hydrating, lightweight, and gives the most gorgeous dewy finish—without feeling greasy. Plus, the SPF 50…Yes, please! My skin looks fresh, healthy, and protected all day. And I love that the cap measures the perfect amount! Genius

So oily skin brown skin girlie here, this is one of the best sunscreens i have ever used uhm its gives my skin a nice glow and no white cast! None at all. If your thinking about giving it a try do it.. its not like you cant return it .. just saying :)

Susan and the Naturium team nailed it. It's SPF 50, it's glowy, it's cosmetically elegant, it layers well under makeup, it reapplies well. This is the one, I will forever re-purchase and recommend to all my peoples!

I'm on my 3rd tube of this spf moisturizer and it works great for me. I have dry, sensitive skin and my forehead tends to sunburn easily. I use a tiny bit of bio-oil as a base then put a few pumps of this over the top and that's it for the day. It protects perfectly. I don't wear makeup, so I can't speak to that. I like the tube and pump dispenser because I can squeeze it like a toothpaste tube and get every last drop out, unlike with bottles/jars. Love the dewy finish - isn't greasy.
I tried waiting awhile for this to fully dry, but it didn't matter, it just pills right off when I put makeup on afterwards. Bummer, I really liked the idea of this since I live in the desert

Saw product recommendation from a black dermatologist on TikTok. I wanted to give it a try. I will be seeing if i can layer make up over the product. I would recommend setting it to help it dry down faster. It could have been the fact i didn't wait 15 mins tho. I would definitely wear this daily to replace my regular sunscreen.
One of my favorite spfs! I have repurchased this so many times. I have dry skin so something super moisturizing like this works really well for my skin. I love the way it makes my skin look!

avis.titre: Actually dewy with no white cast
avis.texte: I got both this one and the tinted one. At first I was worried that this would leave a white cast on my dark skin but I just took about 30 minutes to blend it in and it looked great! The cap feature is pretty cool too. As I learn more about sunscreen I realized the likelihood that I'm using less than the effective amount. The cap actually measures out to the perfect amount! I love it!

For US sunscreens, this is probably my favorite. I do prefer Korean sunscreens overall for my face, but this one is good too! If you have normal to dry skin, she is your girl. It can be a little shiny or greasy looking, so I would avoid if you have oily skin for sure. I love that this is a moisturizer combined with SPF so you can just combine steps. The part I probably like best is that once your rub it in, you really don't smell sunscreen unless you put your nose right up to it. My mom who has dry skin loves this and her skin drinks it right up. I introduced her to it and it may be her first sunscreen for her face that she's used. Like I said, I do really like this for US sunscreens and if I'd never tried Korean sunscreens, I'd still use it as my number one probably. I still like to keep this on hand and highly recommend it to folks with dry skin. I received this product free in exchange for my honest review, and I've also purchased this product on my own as well beforehand.
Loved this sunscreen, gave me such a pretty glow. I do think its a but over priced for the amount in the packaging but willing to repurchase.
Finally found a sunscreen that i can wear under makeup. Ive tried so many and this is rhe best! Isnt too thick and leavs a beautiful finish! Doesnt become white and casty with makeup!
I love everything Naturium, but this sunscreen is fabulous! I never could find a sunscreen that I liked, but this right here, is the one

I've always had trouble with skin care - esp in the morning. The smell always got to me, I didnt like the feeling of SPF, etc. I'm able to use this every day, no problem. And I get compliments on my skin constantly. Really happy with it.

It's just ok. I was looking for a less expensive alternative to the Elta MD tinted SPF and so I tried this one in shade light. It's a little too greasy (I guess glowy if you have super dry skin) and the color oxidizes and looks orange on my fair skin after a little while. I'll use it in a pinch but won't reach for it daily like I do with the Elta MD. Also has a very distinct sunscreen smell which I don't love. Lots of other items from Naturium to love, this one just wasn't for me.
I hear naturium was a good product line so i grabbed this once when my regular moisturizer was out. Hasnt pilled with my nars or cushion foundations!

avis.titre: Smoothed the texture of my skin! Amazing
avis.texte: I have purchased one bottle of this and it's been working wonders! I use 3-4 pumps on my face and neck everyday (I don't wear foundation) and it doesn't pill or make my powder a funny texture. I do recommend exfoliating when using this. Niacinamide is amazing! My acne scars are less red and less noticeable.

so greasy, does not have clean ingredients. has acne causing ingredients which is probably why I was breaking out from using it. also does not feel good on the skin. would nto repurchase or even use again

so greasy, does not have clean ingredients. has acne causing ingredients which is probably why I was breaking out from using it. also does not feel good on the skin. would nto repurchase or even use again

avis.titre: Just bought this and love it so far!
avis.texte: It doesn't pill, gives a subtle glow, and blends so nicely. I love it!
